name: Granville Harbour Wind Farm
current_developer: Granville Harbour Operations Pty Ltd as trustee for Granville Harbour Operations Trust
notable: 111 MW wind farm on Tasmania's rugged west coast. 31 Vestas V117-3.6 MW turbines. Tasmania's second-largest wind farm. Developed by Palisade Investment Partners.

timeline.title: Construction commenced
timeline.detail: Palisade Investment Partners began construction on west coast of Tasmania

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Granville Harbour Wind Farm — other source (v3.31.0 wind tranche 2)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Reece 220 kV / Zeehan area on Tas west coast network
eis_specs.notes: Regime: other. Approved by West Coast Council under Tas LUPA Act 1993. Vestas turnkey EPC awarded 2018; commissioned Dec 2020. Owned by Palisade Investment Partners; 111 MW. Uses tallest hub-height tower in Australia (137 m) at time of construction.
